limitations.note: The arithmetic rewrite implicitly corrected the two bad 1-yuan transitions, but also replaced combinational output decoding with registered outputs, counted simultaneous inputs together instead of prioritizing d1, and added a multi-cycle change queue.
The replacement kept the ports but removed the original public state parameters, so an existing instantiation that overrides one of them would no longer elaborate.
The scoreboard reproduced the rewrite’s edge-counting, simultaneous-coin, and queued-change assumptions instead of checking that the corrected FSM preserved its original observable behavior.

limitations.note: A rejected cleanup trap prevented the entire test command from starting, so the agent had to resubmit the long command with a different cleanup method.
